text:
Maya: Heads up — saw 99th percentile token latency jump for some tenants in eu-west-1 dedicated pools around 06:13 UTC. Graph shows KV cache eviction spikes aligned with tenant cold bursts. Anyone digging?

Jon: saw it too, digging logs now. likely noisy neighbor from a training job? but these are dedicated pools — surprising.

Liam: Could be cache pressure from multi-tenant shard packing. eviction metric: `kv_cache_evictions_total` jumped x4. I'll check allocation map.

Devon: @Liam please check if these tenants were on the same slice. If so, we might need temporary shielding (eviction-shield) + route to shared-warm cache.

infra-bot: ALERT: eviction-burst-detector triggered for pool eu-west-1-dedicated-3 at 2026-03-18T06:13:42Z

Jon: quick mitigation idea: add per-tenant soft-reserve tokens so a tenant can absorb short bursts without flushing shared KV. Implement by changing router policy to prefer nodes with free `cache_budget >= burst_tokens`.

Liam: agree. Also propose short-term: route high-request-rate tenants to ccache-warm pool (lower GPU utilization but larger cache) via route policy.

Maya: sketch of policy tweak:
```json
{
  "route_policy": "prefer-warm-cache",
  "conditions": [
    {"metric": "request_rate", "threshold": ">200rps"},
    {"metric": "kv_cache_evictions_total", "threshold": ">10/min"}
  ],
  "actions": ["route_to_pool:ccache-warm", "apply_eviction_shield:60s"]
}
```

Devon: can we do an A/B rollout? I can push a canary policy to eu-west-1-dedicated-3 with `canary: 4` and monitor `tail_latency`.

Jon: do it. Also add metric alert for `kv_cache_evictions_total` > 100/min per pool.

Maya: rolling the canary now. I'll post updates. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-bot: policy-change canary pushed to eu-west-1-dedicated-3 by Maya at 06:21 UTC

Liam: initial reports look promising — evictions down 60% on canary slice. keep monitoring, then decide if permanent.
